set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=91c602018157db008d1814bc24f0bfc727ce1e0e; PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101; git fetch --quiet origin main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; test -e "$PORT"; . ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; grep -q '^CONFIG_IDF_TARGET="esp32c6"' sdkconfig; grep -q '^IDF_TARGET:STRING=esp32c6' build/CMakeCache.txt; echo '=== BUILD SCD4X GATEWAY ==='; idf.py build; test -e "$PORT"; echo '=== FLASH ESP32C6 (NO ERASE) ==='; idf.py -p "$PORT" flash; echo '=== WAIT FOR PORT ==='; for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ -e "$PORT" ] && break; sleep 0.5; done; test -e "$PORT"; echo '=== SERIAL MONITOR 100S ==='; python - <<'PY'
import serial, time
port='/dev/cu.usbmodem1101'
s=serial.Serial()
s.port=port
s.baudrate=115200
s.timeout=0.20
s.write_timeout=1
s.dtr=False
s.rts=False
s.open()
end=time.monotonic()+100
try:
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        data=s.readline()
        if data:
            print(data.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip(), flush=True)
finally:
    s.close()
PY
test -e "$PORT"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
